title: Workspace review lifecycle and concurrency
description: Run installed native reviewers through isolated production gateways. Prove exact-commit reports, retained task files and skills, source cleanup, three overlapping reviews and capacity rejection while two live browser smoke tasks retain their runtime slots.

single-review.intent: Complete a real review with no slot, retain its report and completed task files, and remove only its source checkout.

concurrent-reviews.intent: Three real reviewers overlap, a fourth exceeds host capacity, and two real browser smoke tasks remain responsive with unchanged runtime-slot ownership.

cancel-review.intent: Cancel an accepted real reviewer, confirm native closure, retain its terminal identity and remove its checkout.

restart-gateway.intent: Kill and restart the gateway during an accepted review after removing the original skill/config; recover the same reservation and frozen skill, finish and retain its report.

source-write-denied.intent: Native tool history proves an attempted source write failed; the reviewer still completes and retains its static report.

repeat-review.intent: Request incremental review after a completed workspace review. Retain the prior findings and exact head in the new task, explicitly fall back to a full pass, and verify distinct accepted sessions and cleaned checkouts.

cancel-allocation.intent: Cancel while an owned Git command is paused during checkout creation. The cancellation RPC returns within 15 seconds, the exact Git process stops, and no reviewer or checkout survives.

restart-allocation.intent: Restart the gateway during checkout creation, recover the existing allocation, and complete one reviewer with its retained report and cleaned checkout.

restart-cleanup.intent: Restart the gateway while Git removes a completed review checkout, then verify the original session and report survive and cleanup completes.

restart-launch.intent: Restart the gateway before native task acceptance. Recover the same reserved session and command, finish exactly one review, and retain the report after process and checkout cleanup.

node-authority.intent: Restart a separate production node during review, recover its original native session, then revoke its credential and refuse new reviews and native history access while preserving the completed result.

cancel-launch.intent: Cancel while the native server is starting but has not accepted the reviewer command. Stop the reserved process and remove its checkout.

cancel-cleanup.intent: Cancel during checkout removal after the review has completed. Interrupt the original cleanup, finish owned cleanup and retain the completed review report.

blocked-review.intent: A real reviewer marking blocked retains its reason, closes its owned process and cleans its checkout without becoming a failed or completed review.
